{{recipesummary|category=Salad recipes|time=30 minutes|difficulty=3}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Side dishes | Side dishes]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Canada | Canadian Cuisine]]

The origins of '''potato salad''' can be traced to Germany before the turn of the 17th century, where it first became popular to use vinegar and spices on potatoes as a side dish. The salad has a bite to it and is served warm as often as not.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound |pounds]] (~1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]]) [[Cookbook:Potato |potatoes]]
* 6 slices of [[Cookbook:Bacon |bacon]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (120 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) finely-[[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] yellow [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar |sugar]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Celery|celery seed]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Hard Boiled Eggs|hard boiled eggs]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 g) [[Cookbook:Flour |flour]]
* ½ cup (120 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Vinegar |vinegar]]
* 1 cup (240 ml) [[Cookbook:Water |water]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] fresh [[Cookbook:Parsley |parsley]]
* 1 ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt |salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper |Pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Paprika |Paprika]]

== Procedure ==
# Cook bacon strips, cut into small pieces, and set aside for later.
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] potatoes for 5–10 minutes or until softened; cut into small chunks or thick slices.
# Place potatoes in a large bowl and let them come to room temperature.
# In a bowl combine flour, celery seed, parsley, chopped onion, salt, and pepper.
# Pour the water and vinegar into a pot, stir in sugar and bring to a boil. Add the dry mixture and stir until thickened.
# In the original bowl place potatoes and bacon, pour on thickened mixture.
# Break apart eggs and stir lightly into the bowl to combine. 
# Place in large serving bowl and sprinkle with paprika. 
# Serve

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* Potatoes may be boiled whole in skins, cooled, and carefully peeled to leave the thin, yellow protein layer intact for improved nutritional value and flavour. Slice at room temperature or chilled.
* Chopping the potatoes into small pieces allow more surface to be coated and improves the flavour.
* You can omit salt and use a chicken-flavoured bouillon cube instead. Add chopped onion to bouillon and simmer for a few minutes to blend flavours.
* Salad can be served chilled or warm to preference.

== See also ==
* [[Cookbook:Ensalada Rusa|Ensalada Rusa]], a Uruguayan potato salad containing [[Cookbook:Peas|peas]] and [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]].
* [[Cookbook:German Potato Salad|German Potato Salad]], a warm salad containing [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]].
* [[Cookbook:Grammy's Potato Salad|Grammy's Potato Salad]], a New England style recipe.
* [[Cookbook:Potato Salad (American)|Potato Salad (American)]], another American-style recipe made with [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]] and sweet relish.
